items.title: # Simple Budget Template
items.content: Create a basic household budget spreadsheet with columns for Income (Source, Amount), Fixed Expenses (Rent, Utilities, Subscriptions), Variable Expenses (Groceries, Entertainment), and Savings.

items.title: # Track Spending Categories
items.content: Generate a spreadsheet for tracking monthly expenses, including columns for Date, Category (e.g., Food, Transport, Shopping), Item, Amount, and Payment Method.

items.title: # Savings Goal Planner
items.content: Design a spreadsheet to help me budget for a [Specific Savings Goal, e.g., vacation, down payment]. Include sections for goal amount, target date, current savings, and monthly contribution needed.

items.title: # Income Expense Overview
items.content: Provide a simple spreadsheet template to compare total monthly income against total monthly expenses. Include a 'Difference' column to show surplus or deficit.

items.title: # Weekly Meal Planner
items.content: Create a 5-day meal plan for [number] people, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Generate a categorized grocery list based on this plan. I prefer [cuisine type] cuisine and have [dietary

items.title: # Invent Recipes Now
items.content: I have the following ingredients: [list ingredients]. Suggest 3 dinner recipes I can make, along with a brief instruction for each. Focus on [cooking style/difficulty].

items.title: # Budget Grocery Guide
items.content: Generate a grocery list for [number] days of meals for [number] people, focusing on budget-friendly ingredients. Prioritize [protein source] and include [number] snacks. List items by aisle.

items.title: # Healthy Prep Ideas
items.content: I want to meal prep healthy lunches for 4 days. Suggest 3 different recipes that are easy to make ahead and list the ingredients needed for each. Focus on [dietary goal, e.g., high protein, low carb].

items.title: # Analyze Both Sides
items.content: Analyze the topic '[Topic]' by presenting strong arguments for and against it. Provide key points for each side to help me understand the full scope.

items.title: # Generate Counterpoints
items.content: Given the main argument: '[Your Main Argument]', generate three potential counter-arguments that an opponent might raise. For each, suggest a brief rebuttal.

items.title: # Structure Your Debate
items.content: Help me structure an argument for '[Topic]' for an audience of '[Audience]'. Outline a clear introduction, 3 main points with supporting evidence, and a strong conclusion.

items.title: # Spot Logical Fallacies
items.content: Review this statement/argument: '[Opponent's Argument]'. Identify any logical fallacies present and explain why they are fallacious in simple terms.

items.title: # Outline My Statement
items.content: Generate a detailed outline for a graduate school personal statement for [Program Name] at [University Name]. Focus on my unique experiences in [Field/Skill] and future goals.

items.title: # Draft My Intro
items.content: Write a compelling introductory paragraph for a personal statement for [Program Name]. I want to highlight [Key Achievement] and my passion for [Specific Area].

items.title: # Connect My Experiences
items.content: Help me narrate how my experience in [Previous Role/Project] directly prepared me for [Specific Aspect of Grad Program]. Emphasize skills like [Skill 1] and [Skill 2].

items.title: # Refine My Essay
items.content: Review this personal statement draft for clarity, conciseness, and impact. Suggest improvements for flow, grammar, and stronger vocabulary. [Paste your draft here]

items.title: # Brainstorm Gift Ideas
items.content: I need gift ideas for [Recipient's Relationship, e.g., my mom, my friend]. They enjoy [Hobbies/Interests] and their personality is [Personality Traits]. Suggest 5 unique gift ideas under [Budget].

items.title: # Experience Gift Ideas
items.content: Suggest 3 experience-based gift ideas for [Recipient's Relationship]. They live in [City/Region] and are interested in [Activity Types, e.g., cooking, adventure, relaxation]. Focus on memorable

items.title: # Personalized Gift Ideas
items.content: I want to create a personalized gift for [Recipient's Relationship]. They appreciate [Type of personalization, e.g., handmade, sentimental, humorous]. Give me 3 DIY gift ideas I can make or customize.

items.title: # Last Minute Gifts
items.content: I need quick, last-minute gift ideas for [Recipient's Relationship] for [Occasion]. I have [Timeframe, e.g., 2 hours, tomorrow morning] and a budget of [Budget]. Suggest 3 easy-to-acquire gifts.

items.title: # Craft Invitations Easily
items.content: Draft a fun and engaging birthday party invitation for a [Age]th birthday. Include details for [Date], [Time], [Location], [RSVP Contact], and [Theme].

items.title: # Brainstorm Party Themes
items.content: Suggest 5 unique and fun birthday party themes for a [Age]-year-old, along with 3 simple decoration ideas for each theme. Focus on [Child's Interests].

items.title: # Plan Fun Games
items.content: Generate 3 interactive and age-appropriate game ideas for a [Age]-year-old's birthday party with a [Theme]. Include brief instructions for each game.

items.title: # Create Party Menu
items.content: Propose a simple and kid-friendly birthday party menu for [Number] guests, considering [Dietary Restrictions, e.g., nut-free]. Include appetizers, main dishes, and dessert options.

items.title: # Create Custom Story
items.content: Write a short bedtime story for a [age group] child about a [animal/character] who learns about [moral/theme]. Include [specific details/setting].

items.title: # Adventures Of [Character]
items.content: Generate a bedtime story where [child's name/character] goes on an adventure to [place] to find [object]. Make it gentle and reassuring for a [age] year old.

items.title: # Interactive Story Time
items.content: Craft a simple interactive bedtime story for a [age] year old. Present two choices at the end of each short paragraph, leading to different gentle outcomes.

items.title: # Rhyming Sleep Story
items.content: Write a soothing, rhyming bedtime story, approximately [number] paragraphs long, about a [object/concept, e.g., cloud, moon] drifting to sleep. Use simple language for [age group].
